record.question: What is called 'Land of the Flying Fish'?
record.explanation: Answer A: Barbados. Barbados is conventionally called the ‘Land of the Flying Fish’; the Caribbean Community country profile uses this sobriquet. Reference: https://si-staging.caricom.org/country_profiles/barbados. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
